subject.title: fix(agents): treat unterminated Responses SSE stream as error, not success

question: Should the shared `openai-responses` transport require a terminal SSE event from every compatible backend, or preserve a defined compatibility path for existing endpoints that end at EOF?
rationale: The PR prevents silent message/session loss, but its fail-closed behavior changes runtime semantics for all providers routed through the shared Responses transport; source review cannot determine the intended upgrade policy.

options.title: Adopt a strict terminal contract
options.body: Treat terminal-less EOF as an error for every `openai-responses` backend and select one canonical boundary implementation with provider-compatibility tests.

options.title: Preserve a bounded compatibility path
options.body: Keep legacy EOF success only for explicitly identified compatible endpoints and retain strict failure for the reported interruption shape.

options.title: Pause for provider evidence
options.body: Collect maintainer-confirmed traces from supported compatible providers before selecting either global behavior.

recommendation.title: Adopt a strict terminal contract
recommendation.body: Treat terminal-less EOF as an error for every `openai-responses` backend and select one canonical boundary implementation with provider-compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-wide provider compatibility direction decision, not a contributor-specific code correction.
